text:
### Step 3: Resolution (Days 5–8)  
**Possible Outcomes:**  
**If FirstUK Bank at Fault:**
- Full financial compensation for loss
- Plus interest (8% per annum) if appropriate
- Plus additional compensation if distress caused
- Written apology
- Process improvement (to prevent recurrence)  
**If Customer at Fault:**
- Explanation of policy/procedure
- Evidence provided
- Polite decline of compensation
- Educational tone (help customer understand)  
**If Unclear/Inconclusive:**
- Explain evidence reviewed
- Acknowledge customer perspective
- Offer partial compensation (if appropriate)
- Explain further steps (e.g., external ombudsman)

raw_entities.name: Complaints Resolution Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the resolution phase of customer complaints (Days 5–8), defining possible outcomes based on fault determination and the bank's obligations for compensation, interest, apologies, and process improvements.
context: Plus interest (8% per annum) if appropriate

raw_entities.name: Full Financial Compensation for Loss
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that FirstUK Bank provide full financial compensation to the customer when the bank is found at fault in a complaint.

raw_entities.name: Interest Payment on Compensation
raw_entities.description: Requirement to pay interest at 8% per annum on compensation amounts when appropriate, as part of the bank's remediation obligation when at fault.
context: Plus interest (8% per annum) if appropriate

raw_entities.name: Additional Compensation for Distress
raw_entities.description: Provision requiring the bank to provide additional compensation beyond financial loss when the customer has suffered distress as a result of the bank's fault.
context: Plus additional compensation if distress caused

raw_entities.name: Written Apology Requirement
raw_entities.description: Requirement that FirstUK Bank issue a written apology to the customer when the bank is found at fault in a complaint.

raw_entities.name: Process Improvement Following Fault
raw_entities.description: Obligation to implement process improvements when the bank is at fault, designed to prevent recurrence of the issue that led to the complaint.

raw_entities.name: Policy and Procedure Explanation When Customer at Fault
raw_entities.description: When a complaint is resolved against the customer, the bank must provide an explanation of the relevant policy or procedure in an educational tone to help the customer understand.

raw_entities.name: Evidence Provision When Customer at Fault
raw_entities.description: Requirement to provide evidence to the customer supporting the bank's decision when the complaint is resolved against the customer.

raw_entities.name: Polite Decline of Compensation When Customer at Fault
raw_entities.description: Provision prohibiting compensation when the complaint investigation determines the customer is at fault, with the bank declining compensation in a polite manner.

raw_entities.name: Explanation of Evidence in Inconclusive Cases
raw_entities.description: When a complaint resolution is unclear or inconclusive, the bank must explain the evidence reviewed and acknowledge the customer's perspective.

raw_entities.name: Partial Compensation in Inconclusive Cases
raw_entities.description: Provision allowing the bank to offer partial compensation when a complaint resolution is inconclusive or unclear, if appropriate.

raw_entities.name: External Ombudsman Referral Explanation
raw_entities.description: Requirement to explain further steps available to the customer, including the option to escalate to an external ombudsman when a complaint resolution is inconclusive.

raw_entities.name: FirstUK Bank
raw_entities.description: The financial institution responsible for implementing the complaints resolution policy, determining fault, and providing appropriate remedies and responses to customers.

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: The party filing a complaint against FirstUK Bank, who may receive compensation, interest, apologies, or educational explanations depending on the resolution outcome.

raw_entities.name: Complaint Resolution Fault
raw_entities.description: The risk that FirstUK Bank may be found at fault in a customer complaint, triggering obligations for financial compensation, interest, apologies, and process improvements.
context: Plus interest (8% per annum) if appropriate
